title: Thutmose IV's Dream Stela

tellings.quote: during his reign, he erected something called the dream stella. And it was him talking about how when he was a young kid before he became Pharaoh, he went and slept under um the shade of the Sphinx and the Sphinx visited him in a dream

plain: The Egyptian pharaoh Thutmose IV is said to have set up a carved stone slab, the Dream Stela, at the Sphinx, telling how as a boy he fell asleep in the Sphinx's shade and the Sphinx came to him in a dream. The researcher Luke Caverns describes it on the show, in his own words rather than the stela's, as the young prince saying 'the Sphinx visited him in a dream' before he became pharaoh. He brings it up as an ancient record of the Sphinx being seen as something that could speak to people; the summary itself does not say what the Sphinx told him.
